entities.description: Matter structure whose internal electrons, energy levels, and spectra are modeled by quantum mechanics.
entities.name: atom

entities.description: Experiment in which particles or waves passing through two slits produce an interference pattern.
entities.name: double-slit experiment

entities.description: Corpuscular particle whose properties and behavior are central to the quantum phenomena described.
entities.name: electron

entities.description: Pattern of alternating light and dark bands produced by wave interference and reproduced by quantum particles statistically.
entities.name: interference pattern

entities.description: Quantum or smallest observable particle of the electromagnetic field.
entities.name: photon

entities.description: Principle that a quantum system displays wave-like or particle-like properties according to the measurement performed.
entities.name: principle of complementarity

entities.description: Principle that photons and matter exhibit both wave-like and particle-like behavior, neither classical description being sufficient alone.
entities.name: wave–particle duality
